title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: Each process must have the correct conservation law or violation stated clearly.

title: Conservation Laws
description: Important Criteria: Identify and explain the relevant conservation laws for each process.

title: Weak Interaction Rules
description: Important Criteria: Correctly apply the rules governing weak interactions, especially for processes involving strangeness.

title: Rate Ratio Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: Provide a clear explanation of the rate ratio for the decay of pi mesons.

title: C-Parity and CP Violation
description: Important Criteria: Mention the conservation of C-parity and CP violation where applicable.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid common mistakes such as misidentifying conservation laws or incorrectly applying them.

title: Units and Factors
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that any numerical factors or units are correctly applied in calculations.

title: Clarity and Structure
description: Important Criteria: Responses should be well-structured and clearly articulated for each process.
